newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil 96 agricultural exports at $12.8 bln - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil 96 agricultural exports at $12.8 bln - report.

text.p: Brazil exported $12.81 billion in agricultural produce in 1996 and imported $2.33 billion, Gazeta Mercantil financial daily reported.

Jose Roberto Mendonca de Barros, economic policy secretary at the Finance Ministry, told Gazeta the $10.48 billion surplus in agricultural trade was 6.07 percent higher than the surplus recorded in 1995.
Mendonca de Barros has gone on holiday and was unavailable to confirm the report.

He told Gazeta he expects the 1996/97 grains and oilseed crop to reach 80 million tonnes. That compares with the latest projection of 77.56 million tonnes from Agriculture Ministry's Agricultural Supply Company (CONAB).
The economic policy secretary also identified agriculture as one of the key areas for attracting investment, predicting $8.0 billion in investment over the next four years.
